main.description: Applies a label to a record in one of the community's spaces. This is how content is hidden, marked as a spoiler, or has its link previews suppressed. The record itself is untouched, since it lives in its author's own repo, but a `hidden` label stops this AppView serving the record: it is withheld from reads and from the events socket, and replies to it see a deletedMessageView in its place. Moderators holding `label.apply` and the record's own author still see it.

space.description: The space the labelled record lives in.

val.description: The label value. `hidden` withholds the record from reads. `spoiler` and `embeds-suppressed` are display hints.

items.description: A URI within the subject record.

scope.description: Narrows the label to specific URIs inside the subject record. Absent means the whole record.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the label.apply permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: No space exists at the given reference.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The scope or val is not valid for the subject record.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
